g.text: HEALTH
move 150 min/wk,
eat colourful, sleep,
no smoke, little
alcohol, vaccinate
PARTICIPATION
family, worship,
work welcomed,
vote, volunteer,
grandparent loud
SECURITY
income/pension,
safe home, NHIS
active, abuse-free,
will written
BP + weight + glucose/HbA1c · lipids · vision (cataract/glaucoma) · hearing · dental ·
feet (diabetics each visit) · cognition + mood (M02 tools) · falls + frailty review ·
prostate/breast/cervical per protocol · TB screen if cough · meds review (M04).
VACCINES: influenza yearly · pneumococcal · COVID boosters · tetanus boosters ·
hepatitis B if at risk — chart + recall; consent + explain (PRO-I M2/M4).
LIFESTYLE PRESCRIPTIONS (write them like drugs): WALK (brisk 30 min × 5 — with
friend/stick where needed) + STRENGTH (bands/weights 2×/wk — sarcopenia reverses!) +
BALANCE (heel-toe, one-leg holds — falls halve) + PLATE (protein each meal, calcium + D,
5 veg/fruit, salt-smart, fluids 1.5–2 L unless restricted) + SLEEP (routine, daylight, less
caffeine/naps — hypnotics last resort, M04) + BRAIN (read, worship, games, grandkids' homework)
+ TEETH (brush + dentures fitted + yearly dentist — chewing = nutrition).
AGEISM (the nurse's bias check): NEVER \"too old for…\" (surgery, rehab, hearing aids,
romance, learning) — assess fitness not age; NEVER elderspeak (\"sweetie/sit down dear\" —
patronising, disempowering); ALWAYS address + explain + consent directly (not via the
\"responsible\" child — autonomy survives grey hair, PRO-I M2/M4); ALWAYS ask goals (\"what
matters to YOU this year?\" — farming? wedding? independence? — care aims there).
CHPS + OPD role: keep registers, recall defaulters, vaccinate outreaches, screen markets/
mosques/churches, teach families (M05) — prevention creates the healthy 80-year-olds
who teach YOU tomorrow. Document promotion given (PRO-I M5: unrecorded = untaught).
Exam line: \"health + participation + security — screen yearly, prescribe lifestyle, ban ageism.\"
